trace.title: Observed failure category
trace.detail:
## Understand

Prompting changes request instructions/examples. RAG supplies current external context.

Fine-tuning updates learned behavior using training data. LoRA is a parameter-efficient adaptation method that learns a lower-rank update while much of the base model remains frozen.

Distillation trains a model from targets produced by a stronger system or other teacher process. These approaches solve different problems.

Consider tuning after a measured behavior gap remains despite clear contracts, good examples and correct evidence. It may help a stable output style or specialized task pattern.

It is not the default way to keep live shipment status current, enforce tenant access, or correct broken document parsing.

Data quality, representativeness, permission, leakage and evaluation matter. Keep train, validation and held-out test purposes separate.

A teacher can transfer mistakes. An adapter/base-model compatibility change is a versioned deployment dependency.

You do not need to train a Transformer to make these integration decisions.
